requirements.description: The user requires energy class D or better, so the building must be in class D, C, B, or any A class.
User wants the building located near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with energy class A1 through D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the center point, nearest first. No requirements on size, capacity, or structure were supplied, so none are applied.
